chunks: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī says: This saying has also been related from the Prophet, may Allāh bless him and his descendants.

key_terms.السَّيِّدُ الرِّضْيُ: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī, the compiler/editor of Nahj al-Balagha
key_terms.صَلَى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ: May Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace

ai.seo_question: What is the source of the saying about contentment in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi attributes this maxim on contentment to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), thereby grounding the concept of spiritual sufficiency in prophetic tradition. This attribution underscores the Shia scholarly view that the ethical teachings in Nahj al-Balagha are not merely rhetorical but carry the weight of divine revelation and prophetic authority.
